profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a public company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CRM. Its most recently reported annual revenue was $41,525,000,000 for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026, as disclosed in a 10-K filing. The company operates across customer relationship management software and related cloud services, and owns the Slack messaging platform as well as the Tableau business intelligence platform.

On the AI side, the company tracks three primary products. Slack AI is embedded directly in the Slack messaging platform and the company describes it as offering channel and thread summarization, daily recaps, AI-powered search, meeting note-taking, conversation translation, and workflow automation, with a personal agent called Slackbot that the site says adapts to a user's tone and style. The site states that customer data is not used to train large language models and that LLM providers do not have access to customer data, with models hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud. Salesforce Einstein and Agentforce represent the company's broader CRM-embedded AI and agent platform, with Slack described as the conversational interface through which Agentforce agents can operate. Tableau AI, branded under the Einstein name, provides AI capabilities within Tableau's business intelligence environment, including natural language querying and CRM data integration with a Trust Layer governance component.

The held facts show 175 legal cases associated with California exposure and six Model Context Protocol servers registered to Salesforce-related integrations, covering SOQL query access, Salesforce administration, and DevOps pipeline management. No SEC enforcement actions or patent facts are noted beyond the standard 10-K filing.
